dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Symmetrical and continuous 2D narrowing of the visible body mass from the mid-section towards the posterior terminus.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Mature white; high median pixel intensity with minimal visible pigmentation.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Low-density, faint greyish clusters localized on the posterior dorsal surface.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse gradients between white baseline and light-grey pigmented patches.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Single high-contrast, dark circular focal mark situated posterior to the blowhole; a smaller dark point is visible on the right lateral margin.

other_distinctive_markers: A prominent dark focal mark on the dorsal head region posterior to the blowhole serves as a unique identification feature.
